description: Provider-free end-to-end turn profile: spawn, first event, stream parse, validate, persist. Baselines only. No numeric pass/fail budget.
digest_note: sha256_lf is the SHA-256 of the fixture after LF normalisation (CRLF rewritten to LF). scripts/tests/v3/harness/fixtures have eol unspecified in .gitattributes, so a Windows autocrlf checkout stores CRLF. The digest is of the LF-normalised bytes so the same file matches on those checkouts. .gitattributes was not changed.

hosts.floor: D-028: kernel 6.12 LTS primary and 6.6 LTS compatibility minimum; cgroup v2 required; local ext4. WSL2 is development/test only and is not this profile.
D-028: Windows 11 25H2 build 26200 Home/Pro minimum; also qualify 24H2 build 26100 Enterprise. x64 primary. Canonical state on local NTFS.

stability.definition: relative IQR = IQR / median, with IQR = p75 - p25. MAD/median is reported beside it. MAD is the median of absolute deviations from the median.
stability.percentile_method: Hyndman-Fan type 7 (linear interpolation between closest ranks).

pilot.sigma: sample standard deviation of the five pilot total_ns values, divided by their mean
pilot.formula_note: Same shape as pyperf 2.10.0 pyperf/_bench.py (n = ceil(4 * Z^2 * sigma^2 / W^2), sigma = stdev/mean, Z = 1.96). That source uses W = 0.01 for a 1% target. This preregistration uses W = 0.05 as specified for W1. Required N is frozen from the pilot of 5 and is not recomputed as more turns are added.

proposed_by_agent.note: Lucas can amend these. They are not approved budgets. A series is marked unstable only when the cap stops collection before required N and relative IQR of total_ns still exceeds relative_iqr_max. That mark does not fail the process.

dimensions.name: authority, safety, privacy, effects
dimensions.required_observation: violations, ambiguous outcomes, stale actions, isolation and policy-conformance results
dimensions.null_reason: Provider-free fixture replay does not issue an effect, check isolation, or record a policy decision.

dimensions.name: verified quality
dimensions.required_observation: accepted gate quality, escaped defects, verifier disagreement and falsifier outcomes
dimensions.null_reason: No accepted-gate result, escaped defect, or verifier disagreement is produced.

dimensions.name: recovery and replay
dimensions.required_observation: restart/reconciliation success, replay parity, bounded data loss and failure containment
dimensions.null_reason: The frozen stream is parsed once. This is not a restart, a reconciliation, or a replay-parity check against a live session.

dimensions.name: owner/operator cost
dimensions.required_observation: review minutes, intervention count, comprehension/error probes and backlog age
dimensions.null_reason: No review minutes, intervention count, or comprehension probe is collected.

dimensions.name: quota, tokens and money
dimensions.required_observation: provider-reported counters where exposed, account-window change and metered receipts; unavailable is not zero
dimensions.null_reason: Fixture usage fields are not a provider-reported account window or a metered receipt. Unavailable is not zero.

dimensions.name: context/cache efficiency
dimensions.required_observation: directly observed reads/writes, reusable bytes/tokens, fidelity misses and invalidations
dimensions.null_reason: No cache read, write, invalidation, or fidelity miss is observed. A cached_input_tokens field in a fixture is not a measurement.

dimensions.name: latency and throughput
dimensions.required_observation: p50/p95/p99 control, input, append, task and recovery latency plus accepted throughput

unavailable.input_append_recovery_latency: W1 times spawn, first event, parse, validate, and persist only.
unavailable.accepted_throughput: Provider-free replay has no accepted-task throughput.
unavailable.p99: Reported per phase as null until n >= 100.

dimensions.name: host resources
dimensions.required_observation: CPU, RSS, disk, I/O, network, wakeups, processes and handles

unavailable.disk: Not measured. No stdlib counter is read for disk bytes.
unavailable.io: Not measured. No stdlib counter is read for I/O bytes.
unavailable.network: The network guard refuses connections. Byte counts are not collected.
unavailable.rss_on_windows: resource.getrusage is not in the stdlib on Windows. RSS is null there unless a later change finds a stdlib-only counter.

dimensions.name: terminal interaction
dimensions.required_observation: frame/input latency, flicker/gap count, Unicode/input correctness and accessibility results
dimensions.null_reason: No frame, input, flicker, Unicode, or accessibility observation is taken.

dimensions.name: portability/configurability
dimensions.required_observation: supported platform/route matrices, fail-closed unknowns and owner-change cost
dimensions.null_reason: Host floors are listed with measured false. One runner does not establish a platform matrix or a fail-closed unknown.

dimensions.name: code and maintenance surface
dimensions.required_observation: privileged/total code, dependencies, binary/install size, upgrade work and defect density
dimensions.null_reason: Privileged code, dependency set, binary size, and defect density are not measured.

dimensions.name: extensibility/idle cost
dimensions.required_observation: plugin/frontend compatibility and disabled-path imports, reads, work, processes and calls
dimensions.null_reason: No plugin or disabled-path import, read, process, or call is measured.
